name: Ha cao
summary: Há cảo is a fried dumpling sold with bánh gối.
origin: Hanoi. Vietnam Tourism’s Hanoi street-food article lists it with the other fried snacks and does not print a filling.
howToEat: Order it with the bánh gối snacks.
where: Sold with the bánh gối snacks.
seoDescription: Há cảo in Hanoi is the fried dumpling Vietnam Tourism sells alongside bánh gối. A filling and a street were not printed.
